article.story: BETHLEHEM, Pa. -- — Hank Alvey scored 16 points to help Lehigh hold off Marist 65-60 on Friday night. Alvey also added seven rebounds for the Mountain Hawks (2-2). Joshua Ingram scored 14 points, shooting 5 of 7 and 4 of 5 from the free-throw line. Dywane Chess finished with 19 points and eight rebounds for the Red Foxes (1-3). Jadin Collins added 18 points and Jordan Gabriel pitched in with 14 points and six rebounds. Lehigh went into the half leading Marist 30-23. The Mountain Hawks took the lead for good with 1:55 remaining on a layup from Jalen Vazquez to make it a 58-56 game. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
